english.note: Use 鐵路 as the all-purpose noun for the railway system or rail transport.
This is the all-purpose term for the railway as a transport system; use 路軌 when you mean the physical tracks.
This is the all-purpose choice for the railway system and, when context is clear, the railway in general.
